runtime_contract.manager_binding: Map Manager/A chassis and FL/FR upright poses to FrontSuspensionState. Do not feed Spin_FL/FR rotation into B geometry.

documented: 992 GT3 RS uses a double-wishbone front axle.
Front-axle links use teardrop-shaped aerodynamic profiles.
Porsche reports around 40 kg additional front-axle downforce at top speed from these aero links.
Reduced braking pitch is a separate suspension-geometry measure; Porsche describes the front ball joint of the lower trailing arm as set lower.
